title: Where to Watch Jennifer Lopez’s Vegas Concert Film ‘The JLO Show’ Free Online
summary: The two-hour concert film documents Jennifer Lopez's Las Vegas residency finale in March of this year and premieres on Thanksgiving at 8:00 p.m. ET/PT.
contentText:

The film captures the spectacular finale of Lopez’s sold-out Jennifer Lopez: Up All Night Live in Las Vegas residency at The Colosseum at Caesars Palace, which ran from Dec. 30, 2025, through March 28, 2026. The official trailer, published in September, previews a narration from Lopez as she reflects on growing up watching musicals and how they inspired her career as a singer, actor and dancer. The concert itself showcases the grand finale of her Vegas run, with four acts packed with her most famous hits, musical numbers from Gypsy , West Side Story and Funny Girl , plus covers like Lana Del Rey’s “Young and Beautiful.”

At a Glance: Where to Watch The JLO Show Free Online

- Date & Time: Thursday, Nov. 26 from 8:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. ET/PT

- Channel: CBS

- Stream: Paramount+ Premium (no free trial) or Fubo , Hulu + Live TV and DirecTV (free trials)

Where to Watch The JLO Show

For those who have cable, you can catch the concert film on CBS on Nov. 26 at 8:00 p.m. ET/PT.

Where to Watch The JLO Show for Free Online

For cable cutters, The JLO Show is streaming on Paramount+ Premium , which doesn’t offer a free trial but is running its Black Friday offer of Paramount+ plans for only $2.99 per month for two months. However, if you want to watch for free, we’ve found a workaround for getting access to Paramount+ Premium and CBS via streaming platforms that do offer free trials.
